user_input: Implement the user's attached Phase 2 brief in the existing MediCare AI project in auto-execution mode. Treat the full scope and requirements as: local-first deterministic assistant that previews and confirms changes; persistent reminder/appointment occurrences and restart-safe scheduler with safe claims/idempotency/retries; email delivery and preferences; browser notification support including in-app and web push if feasible; caregiver approval/revocation with authorization enforced in services; reporting/audit/settings/export; UI updates; security/privacy; comprehensive tests; documentation; migrations additive only. No paid AI service required; no arbitrary command execution; preserve CSRF; do not make unsupported or unverified dependency coordinate/version choices.
title: MediCare AI Phase 2 Feature Expansion

assessment_snapshot.intro: The project profile identifies an in-place Java/Maven upgrade with the following known facts:
bullets: Approximately 370 nonblank Java lines; source and UI framework details have not been inspected.
The requested Phase 2 scope spans assistant behavior, persistent scheduling, notifications, caregiver authorization, reporting, settings/export, security, tests, and documentation.
The user requires additive-only migrations, CSRF preservation, no arbitrary command execution, and no unsupported or unverified dependency coordinate/version choices.

proposed_outcome: Expand the existing MediCare AI application in place while preserving its existing stack and behaviors: implement a local-first deterministic assistant that previews and confirms changes; persist reminder and appointment occurrences with restart-safe scheduling, safe claims, idempotency, and retries; support email preferences and delivery plus in-app and feasible web-push notifications; enforce caregiver approval and revocation in services; add reporting, audit, settings, and export; update the UI; strengthen security and privacy; and deliver comprehensive tests and documentation. Use additive-only database migrations, preserve CSRF, avoid arbitrary command execution and paid AI requirements, and verify any dependency coordinates or versions before use.
